title: Station Golden Gate offers a helping hand
description: Ever wonder what it's like to be recovered from the water by the USCG? Here is a small video clip of some man overboard training from Oscar's (mannequin) perspective. Crews practice recovery and 1st aid procedures for P.I.W. (Person(s) In the Water).
